page.overview:
Who is Dairin?

In 295 BG, Dairin welcomed Avatar Kyoshi and her secretary Jinpa to the Fire Nation upon their arrival for the upcoming Festival of Szeto. Kyoshi greeted him in turn, asking to see the Fire Lord. Dairin responded that he was indisposed at that moment, but that she would see the Fire Lord that evening.

Rangi approached the chancellor, reminding him that the palace tour was the first item on his itinerary. He guided the trio to the portrait gallery where, upon request, he informed Kyoshi about the life and accomplishments of Avatar Szeto. Kyoshi also took note of Fire Lord Chaeryu's portrait, asking Dairin about the symbolism of the camellia and peony flowers. Aghast at the recent addition that had not been known to him, Dairin requested that the Avatar tell no one else about the painting.

By evening, Dairin approached Kyoshi's chambers, informing her that the small gathering between the Fire Lord and the Avatar had become a larger garden party of some five hundred Fire Nation nobles. After the end of a small performance, Dairin approached the trio, advising the Avatar that the etiquette was to "mingle" in the direction of the Fire Lord.

Later, Yun arrived at the party and held the nobles hostage. Dairin and his guards arrived in the portrait gallery after the earthbender killed Lu Beifong. Although they believed the false Avatar to be without any earth to bend, Yun bent the pigment in the portraits of the Fire Avatars, smashing the blob on the floor and sending sharp pellets flying at Kyoshi, Dairin, and the guards. As the chancellor had not worn armor, he was mortally wounded. Even the world-renowned healer, Atuat, considered Dairin to be gone when she arrived on the scene.
